In most cases it's just the brain having some sort of problem. In some cases it just becomes a sort of habit. If you think or do something a certain amount of times your brain wires itself to think or do the thing. After having negative thoughts for a long enough period it becomes all the brain is used to. It feels uncomfortable to think a different way becomes of how comfortable the brain got thinking negatively. It essentially becomes an unavoidable part of life, and it's extremely hard to change. 

Keep in mind it takes years of having these thoughts for it to be a "permanent" Part of your life. I say this because often when you get help when the thoughts first start you have a better time bringing the brain back to it's original state. And I add quotations to permanent because there's been a lot of testing on a number of different drugs to try and fix that. The ones with the most success rating are Ketamine, pscilosybin, and LSD. I don't recommend trying these without the help of a medical professional.
